card.name: Dosing interval before a number of weeks
card.fires_on: The space or the word 'every' right before a number of weeks or doses in nivolumab and ipilimumab dosing schedules. It fires where a dosing interval such as 3 weeks, 6 weeks or 4 doses comes next.

modes.label: Space before interval number
modes.description: The space right after 'every' or 'for', just before the number of weeks or doses.
modes.example: then 240 mg every<< >>2 weeks or 480 mg

modes.label: The word every
modes.description: The word 'every' after a mg/kg dose, just before a number of weeks.
modes.example: 360 mg every 3 weeks with ipilimumab 1 mg/kg<< every>> 6 weeks

card.plain: It marks the spot in a combination cancer-drug schedule where the number of weeks between doses comes next.
